اعتمرتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرَتَا (iʕtamaratā) /iʕ.ta.ma.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرَتَا (uʕtumiratā) /uʕ.tu.mi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
